messages:
Aria N: Postmortem follow-up: need owners and firm deadlines for customer comms + a remediation verification step. We should settle: short statuspage line, a plain-language incident summary, and the policy for sharing deeper RCAs.
Ben K: I can take the statuspage line and the 400-word summary. ETA tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Will keep it readable and include a one-liner for 'how to request more'.
Sofia P: Support will export affected accounts and flag contract-SLA customers. ETA: today 18:00. I'll include impact tiers and suggested AM owners.
Ravi M: Ops asks: publish short status note ASAP (1-2 lines) for transparency, then publish the sanitized summary within 48h after Legal redaction pass. Also propose adding a remediation verification field in the tracker so owners mark "verified" with a short evidence note (no logs).
Legal Team: Agreed. Public sanitized summaries OK. Anything with customer identifiers, raw traces, or internal logs requires review and typically a signed DSA; route requests through Support. We'll provide a redaction checklist + a standard response template for AMs.
Aria N: Decision items: Ben -> statuspage + plain summary draft by 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Sofia -> affected list + SLA flags by EOD today. Legal -> redaction checklist + template in 24h. Ravi -> add "verified" step to remediation tracker and automation for a 7-day verification reminder.
Ben K: Draft will include: impact timeline, what we did to mitigate, and next steps + link to remediation tracker (read-only). No internal IDs, no commit hashes.
Sofia P: Outreach cadence: SLA customers get an early tailored email within 24h of summary sign-off; all affected accounts see sanitized summary via statuspage + ticket within 48h.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1248 moved to postmortem by @aria at 2026-04-20T11:02:40Z.
Aria N: I'll capture owners/times in the action tracker and run a mid-week check-in. Also let's add a recurring-pattern register item: Product + SRE to review similar incidents weekly for 6 weeks to detect trends.
Ravi M: Sounds good. I'll create the register and link it from the summary so customers can see if this aligns with known patterns (high-level only).
Ben K: Posting draft to #incidents-drafts shortly for quick review (please focus on tone + redaction).
Aria N: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread after tracker entries are updated. :white_check_mark:
